[size=5][color=#d9d2e9]This mod includes full beautification for children, and when they grow up, their children will get seasonal costumes, 4 seasons and 8 festivals, and they will also be enabled in the night market[/color][color=#b4a7d6]![/color]
[/size][/font]



[font=Comic Sans MS][size=6]The pre-emption it requires is [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6278][size=6]Unique Children

[/size]

[/url][size=5]You need to extract this file and install it into the mod folder

[/size][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]If you want to have a conversation with your child, you can pair this with this[/size][/font][font=Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9540][size=5]Unique Children Talk[/size]
[/url][/font][font=Comic Sans MS]
